description: Zbiralniki odpadne elektronske in električne opreme v občini Ribnica is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA RIBNICA. The collection contains data on collectors of waste electronic and electrical equipment (WEEE) in the municipality of Ribnica. Coverage: OBČINA RIBNICA. The portal shows the English title as "Collectors of waste electronic and electrical equipment in the municipality of Ribnica" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA RIBNICA. Its keywords include električna oprema, odlagališča, zbiralniki, elektronska oprema, odpadki. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
